text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer, you're looking rather<n>exhausted. Oh
dear, that won't do. I<n>know just the thing...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's get dancing! Come on, now!<n>Give me
dynamic! Open up those<n>joints!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Faster, faster—raise the<n>beat! Well? I bet
that raised your<n>heartbeat too, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Being tired is no excuse to do<n>nothing—no, no.
Feeling sluggish?<n>Dance. Anxious? Take the dive.
Remember that!
